summary: [¶] Regulatory Compliance Application on account of change in name of the transmission licensee from ‘Maheshwaram Transmission Limited’ to ‘Maheshwaram Transmission Private Limited’. [¶] The Petitioner, Maheshwaram Transmission Limited (now known as [¶] Maheshwaram Transmission Private Limited), has filed the present Regulatory Compliance Application seeking approval for the change in the name of the [para 3] 3. The Petitioner has submitted that an application under Section 14(1) of the Companies Act, 2013 read with rule 41 of the Companies (Incorporation) Rules, 2014 was filed before the Regional Director (WR), Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Mumbai, seeking approval for the conversion of the company into a Private Limited Company, which was duly approved _vide_ Order dated 4.6.2025 by the Regional Director. Thereafter, the Regional Director sanctioned the alteration of Clause I of the Memorandum of Association, wherein “Maheshwaram Transmission Limited” was substituted with “Maheshwaram Transmission Private Limited”. [para 8] 8. Consequent to the issuance of the certificate dated 2.7.2025, by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, as noted above, we direct that the name of the Transmission Licensee be changed from “Maheshwaram Transmission Limited” to “Maheshwaram Transmission Private Limited” in the records of the Commission. It is further stipulated that Maheshwaram Transmission Private Limited shall remain unequivocally bound by the terms and conditions of the inter-State transmission licence originally granted to Maheshwaram Transmission Limited, provisions of the Transmission Service Agreement, Transmission Licence Regulations, and the Electricity Act. [para 9] 9. We direct that the necessary endorsement be made on the transmission licence with regard to the change of name of “Maheshwaram Transmission Limited” to [para 10] 10. Let an extract copy of this order be sent to the Central Government (the Ministry of Power), the Central Electricity Authority and the Central Transmission Utility of India Limited in terms of sub-section (7) of Section 15 of the Electricity Act, 2003, for their information and record. [para 11] 11. Accordingly, the Petition No. 81/RC/2026 is allowed in terms of the above.
